description: Registration of a child's birth and issuance of a certified copy of the birth certificate through the Municipal Civil Registrar's Office.
steps: Submit the Certificate of Live Birth form accomplished by the attending physician, midwife, or hospital
Present required supporting documents to the Civil Registrar
Pay applicable registration fee (free of charge if registered within 30 days of birth per law)
Receive the registered Certificate of Live Birth; request a certified copy from the PSA (via the civil registrar) if needed
requirements: Certificate of Live Birth (accomplished and signed by attendant at birth)
Marriage certificate of parents (if married)
Valid ID of parent(s) or informant
Affidavit of Acknowledgment/Admission of Paternity (for children of unmarried parents, if applicable)

faqs.question: Is there a fee for registering a birth?
faqs.answer: Registration within 30 days of birth is free under the Civil Registration Law. Late registration fees apply beyond that period — confirm the current fee schedule with the Civil Registrar.

quickInfo.processingTime: Same day for timely registration; longer for late registration
quickInfo.fee: Free within 30 days of birth; late registration fee applies thereafter

description: Mayor's Permit to operate a business within Hermosa, issued or renewed annually through the Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO).
steps: Secure barangay business clearance from the barangay where the business is located
Submit application (new) or renewal form with required documents to BPLO
Settle assessed fees (business tax, Mayor's Permit fee, and related regulatory fees) at the Treasurer's Office
Secure clearances from Sanitary/Health, Fire Safety, and Zoning offices as applicable to the business type
Claim the approved Business Permit and Official Receipt
requirements: Barangay Business Clearance
DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration (sole proprietorship) or SEC Certificate (partnership/corporation)
Valid government-issued ID of the owner/representative
Lease contract or proof of property ownership for the business location
Previous year's Business Permit and Official Receipt (for renewal)
Fire Safety Inspection Certificate
Sanitary Permit / Health Certificate for applicable businesses

faqs.question: When is the deadline for business permit renewal?
faqs.answer: Renewal applications are generally filed on or before January 20 of each year, per the Local Government Code. Confirm the exact municipal deadline with BPLO.

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Business owners operating within Hermosa, Bataan

description: Certification issued by MSWD confirming a resident's indigent status, commonly required for medical, educational, or burial assistance applications.
steps: Request an interview and assessment at the MSWD office
Submit required supporting documents
Receive the signed Certificate of Indigency
requirements: Valid government-issued ID
Barangay Certificate of Residency or Indigency (from the applicant's barangay)
Proof of purpose (e.g., hospital bill, school requirement, burial request)

quickInfo.processingTime: Same day, subject to case assessment

description: Registration and issuance of a Persons with Disability (PWD) identification card through the Person with Disability Affairs Office (PDAO), entitling holders to discounts and benefits under RA 10754.
steps: Accomplish the PWD registration form at PDAO
Submit medical certificate and supporting documents
Have 1x1 ID photo taken on site or submit as required
Claim the PWD ID card once released
requirements: Medical Certificate from a licensed physician specifying the disability
Valid government-issued ID or Birth Certificate
2 pieces 1x1 ID photo
Barangay Certificate of Residency

quickInfo.validity: Subject to renewal per DOH/NCDA guidelines

description: Payment of annual or quarterly real property tax (RPT) on land, buildings, and other improvements within Hermosa, processed at the Municipal Treasurer's Office.
steps: Bring the property's Tax Declaration number or previous Official Receipt to the Treasurer's Office
Request assessment/computation of amount due for the current period
Pay in full (eligible for discount if paid early in the year) or in quarterly installments
Receive the Official Receipt as proof of payment
requirements: Tax Declaration Number or copy of Tax Declaration
Previous year's Official Receipt (if available)
Valid ID of the payor

faqs.question: Is there a discount for early payment?
faqs.answer: Many municipalities offer a discount for full payment made within the first quarter of the year. Confirm the current discount rate and deadlines with the Treasurer's Office.
